subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Neena will visit Greece in May.

options.text: Greece had been visited by Neena in May.
Greece has been visited by Neena in May.
Greece will be visited by Neena in May.
Greece will visit Neena in May

solution:
The **correct answer **is - ***Greece will be visited by Neena in May. ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Given the sentence is: Neena will visit Greece in May.
 
• After analyzing the sentence it is observed that the tense used in the sentence is ***Simple Future Tense.***
 
• The rule to make it to a passive voice is -**Object+shall/will+be+do verb(past participle form)+by+Subject.**
 
• Here the **subject** is **Neena** and **do verb** is **visit** and **object** is **Greece.**
 
• Hence** the Passive Voice **will be** : *Greece will be visited by Neena in May.***

So*** option (3) ***is*** correct. ***
